main_text.p: Reiiciatur commentum Vbiquit: quod simul dives & pauper humanitate. Sic non fuisset verè pauper. Ratio: quia contraria non consistunt simul in eadem natura. Ergo non ditasset nos sua paupertate, &c.
[illegible, ~7 letters]. Ergo vere est promissus Messias.
Ratio 1. quia vere Deus & homo, qualis à prophetis prædictus. Applicentur breviter quædam oracula & utraque natura inde oftendatur.
Gen. 3. Semen mulieris conteret caput serpentis. Ex contritione capitis serpentis Deitas: ex eo quod semen mulieris, Humanitas.
Ies.7. Vocabis nomen eius Immanuel. Deus quia Immanuel: Homo, quia puer comedens butyrum & mel, &c.
Ies.9. Puer natus, &c. Deus, quia Filius absolute, nempe Dei, habens principatum & regnū æternum. Deus fortis, &c. Homo, quia puer na-tus, &c.
Ier.23. Suscitabo Davidi justum germen: Deus, quia rex spiritualis: Item servabit Israelem. Item: Iuda in eo sperabit. Item: vocabitur Iehova ju-stitia nostra. Homo, quia germen Davidis.
Ratio 11. quia natus est homo plane secundum proph. oracula. Subiiciantur breviter præcipuæ circumstantiæ, quomodo prædictæ & impletæ.
1. Tempus: Natus est sceptro ablato Gen.49. & Luc.2.
2. Locus: In Bethlehem Mich. 5. & Matth. 2. Luc. 2.
3. Familia: Exposteritate Davidis. Ier.23. Suscitabo Davidi: & Luc.1. 27. Angelus mittitur ad virginem è domo David.

page.notes: Greek word after the first paragraph's line 2 (before "Ergo vere est promissus") is too faint to read: marked illegible. Gen.49. and Luc.2. spacing as printed. Ratio II is printed as "11". Long s has been normalised to s throughout; "Ies." reads as the printed abbreviation for Isaiah. Final line "4. Pa-" is a hyphenated line end, continuing on the next page.
